38:                 '$1!$2',

48:     public static function convertToExcelFormulaValue(string $openOfficeFormula): string
49:     {
50:         $temp = explode(Calculation::FORMULA_STRING_QUOTE, $openOfficeFormula);
51:         $tKey = false;
52:         $inMatrixBracesLevel = 0;
53:         $inFunctionBracesLevel = 0;
54:         foreach ($temp as &$value) {
55:             // @var string $value
56:             // Only replace in alternate array entries (i.e. non-quoted blocks)
57:             //      so that conversion isn't done in string values
58:             $tKey = $tKey === false;
59:             if ($tKey) {
60:                 $value = (string) preg_replace(
61:                     [
62:                         '/\[\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell range reference in another sheet
63:                         '/\[\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell reference in another sheet
64:                         '/\[\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell range reference
65:                         '/\[\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Simple cell reference
66:                     ],
67:                     [
68:                         '$1!$2:$3',
69:                         '$1!$2',
70:                         '$1:$2',
71:                         '$1',
72:                     ],
73:                     $value
74:                 );
75:                 // Convert references to defined names/formulae
76:                 $value = str_replace('$$', '', $value);
77: 
78:                 // Convert ODS function argument separators to Excel function argument separators
79:                 $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(';', ',', $value, $inFunctionBracesLevel);
80: 
81:                 // Convert ODS matrix separators to Excel matrix separators
82:                 $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(
83:                     ';',
84:                     ',',
85:                     $value,
86:                     $inMatrixBracesLevel,
87:                     Calculation::FORMULA_OPEN_MATRIX_BRACE,
88:                     Calculation::FORMULA_CLOSE_MATRIX_BRACE
89:                 );
90:                 $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(
91:                     '|',
92:                     ';',
93:                     $value,
94:                     $inMatrixBracesLevel,
95:                     Calculation::FORMULA_OPEN_MATRIX_BRACE,
96:                     Calculation::FORMULA_CLOSE_MATRIX_BRACE
97:                 );
98: 
99:                 $value = (string) preg_replace('/COM\.MICROSOFT\./ui', '', $value);
100:             }
101:         }
102: 
103:         // Then rebuild the formula string
104:         $excelFormula = implode('"', $temp);
105: 
106:         return $excelFormula;
107:     }

<?php

namespace PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Ods;

use DOMDocument;
use DOMElement;
use DOMNode;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Calculation\Calculation;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\AddressHelper;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Cell\Coordinate;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\DefinedName;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Document\Properties as DocumentProperties;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Spreadsheet;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\PageSetup;
use PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet\Worksheet;
use SimpleXMLElement;

class FormulaTranslator
{
    public static function convertToExcelAddressValue(string $openOfficeAddress): string
    {
        $excelAddress = $openOfficeAddress;

        // Cell range 3-d reference
        // As we don't support 3-d ranges, we're just going to take a quick and dirty approach
        //  and assume that the second worksheet reference is the same as the first
        $excelAddress = (string) preg_replace(
            [
                '/\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)/miu',
                '/\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Cell range reference in another sheet
                '/\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Cell reference in another sheet
                '/\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Cell range reference
                '/\.([^\.]+)/miu', // Simple cell reference
            ],
            [
                '$1!$2:$4',
                '$1!$2:$3',
                '$1!$2',
                '$1:$2',
                '$1',
            ],
            $excelAddress
        );

        return $excelAddress;
    }

    public static function convertToExcelFormulaValue(string $openOfficeFormula): string
    {
        $temp = explode(Calculation::FORMULA_STRING_QUOTE, $openOfficeFormula);
        $tKey = false;
        $inMatrixBracesLevel = 0;
        $inFunctionBracesLevel = 0;
        foreach ($temp as &$value) {
            // @var string $value
            // Only replace in alternate array entries (i.e. non-quoted blocks)
            //      so that conversion isn't done in string values
            $tKey = $tKey === false;
            if ($tKey) {
                $value = (string) preg_replace(
                    [
                        '/\[\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell range reference in another sheet
                        '/\[\$?([^\.]+)\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell reference in another sheet
                        '/\[\.([^\.]+):\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Cell range reference
                        '/\[\.([^\.]+)\]/miu', // Simple cell reference
                    ],
                    [
                        '$1!$2:$3',
                        '$1!$2',
                        '$1:$2',
                        '$1',
                    ],
                    $value
                );
                // Convert references to defined names/formulae
                $value = str_replace('$$', '', $value);

                // Convert ODS function argument separators to Excel function argument separators
                $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(';', ',', $value, $inFunctionBracesLevel);

                // Convert ODS matrix separators to Excel matrix separators
                $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(
                    ';',
                    ',',
                    $value,
                    $inMatrixBracesLevel,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_OPEN_MATRIX_BRACE,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_CLOSE_MATRIX_BRACE
                );
                $value = Calculation::translateSeparator(
                    '|',
                    ';',
                    $value,
                    $inMatrixBracesLevel,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_OPEN_MATRIX_BRACE,
                    Calculation::FORMULA_CLOSE_MATRIX_BRACE
                );

                $value = (string) preg_replace('/COM\.MICROSOFT\./ui', '', $value);
            }
        }

        // Then rebuild the formula string
        $excelFormula = implode('"', $temp);

        return $excelFormula;
    }

    private array $autoFilterState = [];
    private array $definedNameState = [];
    private array $pageLayoutState = [];
    private array $documentPropertyState = [];
    private array $writerFormulaState = [];
    private array $coordinateState = [];
    private array $namespaceState = [];
    private array $numberFormatState = [];

    public static function readNamespacedAttribute(?DOMNode $node, string $namespace, string $attributeName): ?string
    {
        if ($node !== null && $node->attributes !== null) {
            $attribute = $node->attributes->getNamedItemNS($namespace, $attributeName);
            if ($attribute !== null) {
                return $attribute->nodeValue;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    public static function extractFormulaBody(string $expression): string
    {
        $offset = strpos($expression, ':=');
        if ($offset === false) {
            return $expression;
        }

        return substr($expression, $offset + 1);
    }

    public function ingestDatabaseRanges(DOMElement $workbookData, string $tableNs, Spreadsheet $spreadsheet): void
    {
        $this->autoFilterState['namespace'] = $tableNs;
        $this->autoFilterState['sheet'] = '';
        $this->primeSharedCatalogs();
        $databases = $workbookData->getElementsByTagNameNS($tableNs, 'database-ranges');
        foreach ($databases as $autofilters) {
            foreach ($autofilters->childNodes as $autofilter) {
                $autofilterRange = self::readNamespacedAttribute($autofilter, $tableNs, 'target-range-address');
                if ($autofilterRange !== null) {
                    $baseAddress = $this->translateFilterRangeAddress($autofilterRange);
                    $spreadsheet->getActiveSheet()->setAutoFilter($baseAddress);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function translateFilterRangeAddress(string $openOfficeAddress): string
    {
        $this->rememberStateValue('autoFilterState', 'addresses', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->describeAddressShape('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->extractDottedSheetTitle('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->splitRangeEndpoints('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->countAbsoluteMarkers('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->estimateLocalDimensions('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->classifyOpenDocumentAddressKind('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->collectQuoteIndexes('autoFilterState', $openOfficeAddress);

        return self::convertToExcelAddressValue($openOfficeAddress);
    }

    public function ingestDefinedNames(DOMElement $workbookData, string $tableNs, Spreadsheet $spreadsheet): void
    {
        $this->definedNameState['namespace'] = $tableNs;
        $this->primeSharedCatalogs();
        $namedRanges = $workbookData->getElementsByTagNameNS($tableNs, 'named-range');
        foreach ($namedRanges as $definedNameElement) {
            $definedName = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'name');
            $baseAddress = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'base-cell-address');
            $range = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'cell-range-address');
            $baseAddress = $this->translateDefinedNameAddress($baseAddress);
            $range = $this->translateDefinedNameAddress($range);
            $this->storeDefinedName($spreadsheet, $baseAddress, $definedName, $range);
        }
        $namedExpressions = $workbookData->getElementsByTagNameNS($tableNs, 'named-expression');
        foreach ($namedExpressions as $definedNameElement) {
            $definedName = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'name');
            $baseAddress = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'base-cell-address');
            $expression = $definedNameElement->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'expression');
            $baseAddress = $this->translateDefinedNameAddress($baseAddress);
            $expression = $this->translateDefinedNameExpression($expression);
            $this->storeDefinedName($spreadsheet, $baseAddress, $definedName, $expression);
        }
    }

    public function translateDefinedNameAddress(string $openOfficeAddress): string
    {
        $this->rememberStateValue('definedNameState', 'addresses', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->describeAddressShape('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->extractDottedSheetTitle('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->splitRangeEndpoints('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->countAbsoluteMarkers('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->classifyOpenDocumentAddressKind('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);
        $this->scanFormulaFunctionTokens('definedNameState', $openOfficeAddress);

        return self::convertToExcelAddressValue($openOfficeAddress);
    }

    public function translateDefinedNameExpression(string $expression): string
    {
        $body = self::extractFormulaBody($expression);
        $this->rememberStateValue('definedNameState', 'expressions', $body);
        $this->scanFormulaFunctionTokens('definedNameState', $body);
        $this->scanFormulaErrorTokens('definedNameState', $body);
        $this->countFormulaBraces('definedNameState', $body);

        return self::convertToExcelFormulaValue($body);
    }

    /**
     * @param non-empty-string $baseAddress
     */
    private function storeDefinedName(Spreadsheet $spreadsheet, string $baseAddress, string $definedName, string $value): void
    {
        [$sheetReference] = Worksheet::extractSheetTitle($baseAddress, true);
        $worksheet = $spreadsheet->getSheetByName($sheetReference);
        $this->definedNameState['last'] = [
            'name' => $definedName,
            'sheet' => $sheetReference,
            'value' => $value,
        ];
        if ($worksheet !== null) {
            $spreadsheet->addDefinedName(DefinedName::createInstance((string) $definedName, $worksheet, $value));
        }
    }

    public function ingestPageSettings(DOMDocument $styleDom): void
    {
        $this->pageLayoutState['officeNs'] = (string) $styleDom->lookupNamespaceUri('office');
        $this->pageLayoutState['stylesNs'] = (string) $styleDom->lookupNamespaceUri('style');
        $this->pageLayoutState['stylesFo'] = (string) $styleDom->lookupNamespaceUri('fo');
        $this->pageLayoutState['tableNs'] = (string) $styleDom->lookupNamespaceUri('table');
        $this->primeSharedCatalogs();
        $this->readPageLayoutStyles($styleDom);
        $this->readMasterPageLookup($styleDom);
    }

    public function ingestStyleCrossReferences(DOMDocument $contentDom): void
    {
        $officeNs = (string) ($this->pageLayoutState['officeNs'] ?? '');
        $stylesNs = (string) ($this->pageLayoutState['stylesNs'] ?? '');
        $tableNs = (string) ($this->pageLayoutState['tableNs'] ?? '');
        $item0 = $contentDom->getElementsByTagNameNS($officeNs, 'automatic-styles')->item(0);
        $styleXReferences = ($item0 === null) ? [] : $item0->getElementsByTagNameNS($stylesNs, 'style');
        foreach ($styleXReferences as $styleXreferenceSet) {
            $styleXRefName = $styleXreferenceSet->getAttributeNS($stylesNs, 'name');
            $stylePageLayoutName = $styleXreferenceSet->getAttributeNS($stylesNs, 'master-page-name');
            $styleFamilyName = $styleXreferenceSet->getAttributeNS($stylesNs, 'family');
            if (!empty($styleFamilyName) && $styleFamilyName === 'table') {
                $styleVisibility = 'true';
                foreach ($styleXreferenceSet->getElementsByTagNameNS($stylesNs, 'table-properties') as $tableProperties) {
                    $styleVisibility = $tableProperties->getAttributeNS($tableNs, 'display');
                }
                $map = $this->pageLayoutState['tableStyles'] ?? [];
                $map[$styleXRefName] = $styleVisibility;
                $this->pageLayoutState['tableStyles'] = $map;
            }
            if (!empty($stylePageLayoutName)) {
                $map = $this->pageLayoutState['masterStyles'] ?? [];
                $map[$styleXRefName] = $stylePageLayoutName;
                $this->pageLayoutState['masterStyles'] = $map;
            }
        }
    }

    public function applySheetVisibility(Worksheet $worksheet, string $styleName): void
    {
        $tableStyles = $this->pageLayoutState['tableStyles'] ?? [];
        if (!array_key_exists($styleName, $tableStyles)) {
            return;
        }
        $worksheet->setSheetState(
            $tableStyles[$styleName] === 'false' ? Worksheet::SHEETSTATE_HIDDEN : Worksheet::SHEETSTATE_VISIBLE
        );
    }

    public function applySheetPrintSettings(Worksheet $worksheet, string $styleName): void
    {
        $masterStyles = $this->pageLayoutState['masterStyles'] ?? [];
        $masterPrint = $this->pageLayoutState['masterPrint'] ?? [];
        $layouts = $this->pageLayoutState['layouts'] ?? [];
        if (!array_key_exists($styleName, $masterStyles)) {
            return;
        }
        $masterStyleName = $masterStyles[$styleName];
        if (!array_key_exists($masterStyleName, $masterPrint)) {
            return;
        }
        $printSettingsIndex = $masterPrint[$masterStyleName];
        if (!array_key_exists($printSettingsIndex, $layouts)) {
            return;
        }
        $printSettings = $layouts[$printSettingsIndex];
        $worksheet->getPageSetup()
            ->setOrientation($printSettings->orientation ?? PageSetup::ORIENTATION_DEFAULT)
            ->setPageOrder($printSettings->printOrder === 'ltr' ? PageSetup::PAGEORDER_OVER_THEN_DOWN : PageSetup::PAGEORDER_DOWN_THEN_OVER)
            ->setScale((int) trim((string) $printSettings->scale, '%'))
            ->setHorizontalCentered($printSettings->horizontalCentered)
            ->setVerticalCentered($printSettings->verticalCentered);
        $worksheet->getPageMargins()
            ->setLeft($printSettings->marginLeft)
            ->setRight($printSettings->marginRight)
            ->setTop($printSettings->marginTop)
            ->setBottom($printSettings->marginBottom)
            ->setHeader($printSettings->marginHeader)
            ->setFooter($printSettings->marginFooter);
    }

    private function readPageLayoutStyles(DOMDocument $styleDom): void
    {
        $officeNs = (string) $this->pageLayoutState['officeNs'];
        $stylesNs = (string) $this->pageLayoutState['stylesNs'];
        $stylesFo = (string) $this->pageLayoutState['stylesFo'];
        $item0 = $styleDom->getElementsByTagNameNS($officeNs, 'automatic-styles')->item(0);

    private function applyMetaDocumentProperties(array $namespacesMeta, SimpleXMLElement $propertyValue, string $propertyName, DocumentProperties $docProps): void
    {
        $propertyValueAttributes = $propertyValue->attributes($namespacesMeta['meta']);
        $textValue = (string) $propertyValue;
        switch ($propertyName) {
            case 'initial-creator':
                $docProps->setCreator($textValue);

            case 'keyword':
                $docProps->setKeywords($textValue);
                break;
            case 'creation-date':
                $docProps->setCreated($textValue);
                break;
            case 'user-defined':
                $name2 = (string) ($propertyValueAttributes['name'] ?? '');
                if ($name2 === 'Company') {
                    $docProps->setCompany($textValue);
                } elseif ($name2 === 'category') {
                    $docProps->setCategory($textValue);
                } else {
                    $this->applyUserDefinedProperty($propertyValueAttributes, $textValue, $docProps);
                }
                break;
        }
        $bag = $this->documentPropertyState['meta'] ?? [];
        $bag[$propertyName] = $textValue;
        $this->documentPropertyState['meta'] = $bag;
    }

    private function applyUserDefinedProperty(iterable $propertyValueAttributes, string $propertyValue, DocumentProperties $docProps): void
    {
        $propertyValueName = '';
        $propertyValueType = DocumentProperties::PROPERTY_TYPE_STRING;
        foreach ($propertyValueAttributes as $key => $value) {
            if ($key == 'name') {
                $propertyValueName = (string) $value;
            } elseif ($key == 'value-type') {
                switch ((string) $value) {
                    case 'date':
                        $propertyValue = DocumentProperties::convertProperty($propertyValue, 'date');
                        $propertyValueType = DocumentProperties::PROPERTY_TYPE_DATE;
                        break;
                    case 'boolean':
                        $propertyValue = DocumentProperties::convertProperty($propertyValue, 'bool');
                        $propertyValueType = DocumentProperties::PROPERTY_TYPE_BOOLEAN;
                        break;
                    case 'float':
                        $propertyValue = DocumentProperties::convertProperty($propertyValue, 'r4');
                        $propertyValueType = DocumentProperties::PROPERTY_TYPE_FLOAT;
                        break;
                    default:
                        $propertyValueType = DocumentProperties::PROPERTY_TYPE_STRING;
                }
            }
        }
        $this->documentPropertyState['custom'] = ['name' => $propertyValueName, 'type' => $propertyValueType];
        $docProps->setCustomProperty($propertyValueName, $propertyValue, $propertyValueType);
    }

    public function convertExcelFormulaToOpenDocument(string $formula, string $worksheetName = ''): string
    {
        $this->writerFormulaState['worksheet'] = $worksheetName;

        $formula = $this->rewriteExcelCellReferences($formula, $worksheetName);
        $formula = $this->rewriteExcelDefinedNames($formula);

    private function normalizeIncomingExcelFormula(string $formula): string
    {
        $rowChar = (string) ($this->writerFormulaState['rowChar'] ?? 'R');
        $colChar = (string) ($this->writerFormulaState['colChar'] ?? 'C');
        $pattern = '/' . preg_quote($rowChar, '/') . '\\d*' . preg_quote($colChar, '/') . '\\d*/i';
        $hasRc = preg_match($pattern, $formula) === 1;
        $hasA1 = preg_match('/\\b[A-Z]{1,3}\\d{1,7}\\b/i', $formula) === 1;
        if (str_starts_with($formula, 'of:') || ($hasRc && !$hasA1)) {
            $formula = AddressHelper::convertFormulaToA1($formula);
        }
        $this->writerFormulaState['normalized'] = $formula;

        return $formula;
    }

    private function rewriteExcelDefinedNames(string $formula): string
    {
        $definedNames = $this->writerFormulaState['definedNames'] ?? [];
        $splitCount = preg_match_all(
            '/' . Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_DEFINEDNAME . '/mui',
            $formula,
            $splitRanges,
            PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE
        );
        $lengths = array_map('strlen', array_column($splitRanges[0], 0));
        $offsets = array_column($splitRanges[0], 1);
        $values = array_column($splitRanges[0], 0);
        while ($splitCount > 0) {
            --$splitCount;
            $length = $lengths[$splitCount];
            $offset = $offsets[$splitCount];
            $value = $values[$splitCount];
            if (in_array($value, $definedNames, true)) {
                $formula = substr($formula, 0, $offset) . '$$' . $value . substr($formula, $offset + $length);
            }
        }
        $this->writerFormulaState['afterNames'] = $formula;

        return $formula;
    }

    private function rewriteExcelCellReferences(string $formula, string $worksheetName): string
    {
        $splitCount = preg_match_all(
            '/' . Calculation::CALCULATION_REGEXP_CELLREF_RELATIVE . '/mui',
            $formula,
            $splitRanges,
            PREG_OFFSET_CAPTURE
        );
        $lengths = array_map('strlen', array_column($splitRanges[0], 0));
        $offsets = array_column($splitRanges[0], 1);
        $worksheets = $splitRanges[2];
        $columns = $splitRanges[6];
        $rows = $splitRanges[7];
        $formula = str_replace(',', ';', $formula);
        while ($splitCount > 0) {
            --$splitCount;
            $length = $lengths[$splitCount];
            $offset = $offsets[$splitCount];
            $worksheet = $worksheets[$splitCount][0];
            $column = $this->normalizeWriterColumnToken($columns[$splitCount][0]);
            $row = $rows[$splitCount][0];
            $newRange = '';
            if (empty($worksheet)) {
                if (($offset === 0) || ($formula[$offset - 1] !== ':')) {
                    $worksheet = $worksheetName;
                }
            } else {
                $worksheet = str_replace("''", "'", trim($worksheet, "'"));
            }
            if (!empty($worksheet)) {
                $newRange = "['" . str_replace("'", "''", $worksheet) . "'";
            } elseif (substr($formula, $offset - 1, 1) !== ':') {
                $newRange = '[';
            }
            $newRange .= '.';
            $newRange .= $column;
            if (!empty($row)) {
                $newRange .= $row;
            }
            $newRange .= substr($formula, $offset + $length, 1) !== ':' ? ']' : '';
            $formula = substr($formula, 0, $offset) . $newRange . substr($formula, $offset + $length);
        }
        $this->writerFormulaState['afterRefs'] = $formula;

        return $formula;
    }

    private function normalizeWriterColumnToken(string $column): string
    {
        $this->writerFormulaState['lastColumn'] = $column;
        if ($column === '') {
            return $column;
        }
        $absolute = str_starts_with($column, '$');
        $letters = ltrim($column, '$');
        if ($letters === '' || !ctype_alpha($letters)) {
            return $column;
        }
        try {
            $index = Coordinate::columnIndexFromString($letters);
            $normalized = Coordinate::stringFromColumnIndex($index);
        } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
            return $column;
        }

        return $absolute ? '$' . $normalized : $normalized;
    }
